name: shardstitch
description: Session recovery + cross-tool handoff for Claude Code. Auto-saves your session on stop, recalls verified project memory, and stitches context into the next AI tool when you hit a limit. 100% local. NOTE: this plugin is the Claude Code doorway to ShardStitch — it requires the ShardStitch backend installed (pip install shardstitch, or set SHARDSTITCH_HOME).
